newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Qatar Palestinian stabs Israeli at Gaza crossing.
newsitem.headline: Qatar Palestinian stabs Israeli at Gaza crossing.

text.p: A Palestinian from the Gulf Arab state of Qatar stabbed an Israeli inspector at the Gaza Strip border on Thursday during a security check of a tourist bus bound for Egypt, Israeli police said.
They said the bearded assailant, wielding a "big commando knife", stabbed the inspector in the back while boarding a bus at a roadblock in Rafah in the Gaza Strip. The Israeli was lightly wounded.

Palestinian and Israeli police jumped on the assailant and arrested him. The incident occurred during a routine check of passports. Palestinian police said he was a Palestinian of Gazan origin visiting from Qatar.
Israel has overall responsibility for security at border crossings, including in Palestinian-ruled Gaza, under peace deals with Yasser Arafat's Palestine Liberation Organisation.
